After Nxe7+, your knight forks the king and c8-rook while clearing the way for Bxf7+. Black must recapture, but then Bxf7+ is check and wins the f7 pawn. Follow with Qxd6 and you're winning easily. Look for forcing sequences where one capture enables a devastating second blow—this pattern wins games.
